pride_data.title: DSBSO-based XL-MS Analysis of Breast Cancer PDX Tissues to Delineate Protein Interaction Network in Clinical Samples
pride_data.projectDescription: We applied our previously established Alkyne-A-DSBSO-based in vivo XL-MS analytical platform on two types of breast cancer PDX samples cross-linking. Coupled with the LC-MSn strategy, the experiments enable us to obtain information on cancer-related protein-protein interactions since experimenting on PDX models.
pride_data.sampleProcessingProtocol: Two breast cancer patient-derived xenograft tissues (basal breast cancer and luminal breast cancer) were cryopulverized, and then suspended in cross-linking buffer (20mM HEPES, 150mM NaCl, 1.5mM MgCl2, pH 7.8) containing 2mM DSBSO. After cross-linking, the protein was extracted, digested and fractionated for MS analysis
pride_data.dataProcessingProtocol: MSn data were extracted using MSConvert (ProteoWizard 3.0.10738) before subjected to database searching using Protein Prospector (v.6.0.0). Cross-linked peptides were identified by the integration of MSn data with database search results using the in-house software xl-Tool
